recording_posture.rationale: Agent OS may store diverse operational, observational, conversational, and derived data. Safety is enforced primarily through inspection, quarantine, forgetting, approval, and traceability after save.
not_a_free_pass: secrets must be flagged or quarantined when detected
high-risk actions still require policy and approval checks
local-only private assets and tokens are not made portable by memory policy

protection_requests.anti_abuse_note: A requester may propose protected status, but normal operation must not allow arbitrary self-protection to bypass forgetting or security review.

classification.shape_expectation: high-dimensional, versioned, and allowed to become nested or graph-like

early_approver_identity.upgrade_path: future person detection, authentication, or second factor
